VivaEngageApplicationIntegration.Title: Viva Engage application context provisioning
VivaEngageApplicationIntegration.Description: Allows the app to create Viva Engage communities, read all community properties, update community properties, and delete communities without a signed-in user.
VivaEngageApplicationIntegration.ConsentInformation: Read and write all Viva Engage communities. Requires application 'Community.ReadWrite.All'.
